name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/site-components
description: This site's own layout components: the page title, with the site's icon and author, the footer, with its copyright line, and a full-width frame that keeps the sidebars' components. A site plugin: a repo-only package, never published (private), loaded by package name like every other plugin of ours. See CONTEXT.md.
//files: Repo-only (private), so never packed or published; files, license, publishConfig and repository are here because the package contract is one shape for every plugin of ours (#98).
//exports: Every entry has its type declarations beside it, which build.mjs emits, as every plugin of ours does: the package contract (the package-contract repo guard, #98) holds a site plugin to the same shape as a published one. ./package.json is how Quartz reads the manifest (import.meta.resolve).
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here: the components' vnodes must be the host's Preact's. The types are imported for types only.
//devDependencies: Build-time only: esbuild bundles dist/, and @chaoticgoodcomputing/declarations writes the .d.ts beside each entry (build.mjs).

quartz.name: site-components
quartz.description: This site's page title, footer and full-width frame.
quartz.//components: The loader places one component per config entry, found by the entry's name in PascalCase, so the site config lists this plugin once per component, named `site-page-title` and `site-footer` (CONTEXT.md, Placement).
quartz.//frames: Registered under each frame's own name, which a page type's layout names as its `template` (docs/adr/0002).

SiteFullWidthFrame.displayName: Full width, with the site's chrome
